function.name: calculate_mortgage_payment
function.description: Calculate the monthly mortgage payment given the loan amount, annual interest rate, and number of years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loan_amount.description: The loan amount. This is a float type value.

annual_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. This is a float type value.

years.description: Number of years the mortgage is amortized over.

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time market data, so I can’t give you the exact current rate at this moment. Mortgage rates fluctuate daily based on the economy, lender policies, your credit profile, loan type, and other factors.

If you’re looking for a ballpark figure, U.S. 30‑year fixed mortgage rates have hovered around 5–7 % in recent months, while 15‑year fixed rates tend to be a bit lower. However, the best way to get an accurate rate is to check with a few lenders or use an online rate comparison tool that pulls the latest offers.

Let me know if you’d like more details on how rates are set, how to compare offers, or anything else!
